text:
[LLSU.6.1] Per [LADP]. A dialect for a tier that
doesn't connect to adapters can disable the category
entirely.

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `adapter_dotted_sugar` | `domain.entity t where ...` lowers to `Constructor t where t.entity_id == "domain.entity"` | spell out the constructor form: `Sensor s where s.entity_id == "..."` |
| `adapter_wildcard_glob` | `*` in dotted patterns lowers to regex on the key slot | enumerate specific entities if the glob size is small |
| `adapter_discovery_schemas` | schemas a discovery-driven adapter declares ([RARC.9.4.2]) | use author-declared or fixed schemas |
| `adapter_json_fallback` | `Json` slot type for adapter payloads whose shape can't be statically committed to | stringify at the adapter and require rule-side parsing; or emit multiple narrow schemas per observed type |
| `adapter_retained_slot` | `retained` common slot on author-declared adapter schemas | drop live/snapshot filtering, or query a separate schema |
| `adapter_context_id_slot` | `context_id` common slot on discovery-driven adapter schemas | ignore own-action feedback avoidance |
